RESEARCH PROTOTYPE / CPU BENCHMARK

Physical motion across missing frames

A single known camera moves around a clamped elastic solid. We fit only 6 irregular RGB observations. Gaussian extent follows volumetric material deformation. The second model adds spatially correlated neural stochastic forcing.

Scope: known rest geometry, density, material family, appearance and camera poses. One synthetic scene; local Gaussian posterior approximation. The diffusion network uses separate simulator supervision. Coverage below is a diagnostic, not evidence of calibration across scenes. There is no real-video, unknown-geometry, contact-inference or PIDG baseline result yet.

Observed and reconstructed motion

Black input panels are missing observations. Both physical posteriors use observations before and after the gap. Each image shown is a posterior mean render.

Largest missing interval

3D and uncertainty metrics exclude clamped nodes. Novel-view images are evaluation-only, from a camera orbit offset by 100 degrees. Coverage and interval width should be interpreted together.

Reproducibility and complete measurements

Exact configuration, random seeds, dependency versions, source fingerprint, scores, and numerical diagnostics are recorded below. Gaussian shape covariance and posterior covariance are separate. The stochastic increments are inferred jointly with scene parameters; adding observation noise to a display does not count as trajectory uncertainty. MAP objectives show optimization progress within a model and are not model-evidence comparisons.
